title: sfputil show error-status on a multi-asic box shows no ports
author: sanmalho-git
body:

#### Description

Running command 'sudo sfputil show error-status' on a multi-asic box generates an empty table with no ports.

```
admin@sonic:~$ sudo sfputil show error-status
Port    Error Status
------  --------------
admin@sonic:~$ 
```
This command gets the ports from state_db in [sfputil/main.py](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-utilities/blob/b540f5f8fd73525d05f6cb3d1844849346f471c8/sfputil/main.py#L689), When no ports are defined as part command, then we are getting the ports using

```
ports = state_db.keys(state_db.STATE_DB, 'TRANSCEIVER_STATUS|*')
```

However, on a multi-asic box, this returns an empty list - probably because 'state_db.get_all' is only looking at the global state database. ports related data is present in the asic specific database and not the global database.

This causes sonic-mgmt. tests [test_check_sfputil_error_status](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/platform_tests/sfp/test_sfputil.py#L48) to fail on a multi-asic box.

So, we get an empty list for ports, and thus an empty table.

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
On a multi-asic box do:
1. sudo sfputil show error-status

#### Describe the results you received:
The output has an empty table.

#### Describe the results you expected:
Expect the table to list out all the ports and their corresponding error status.

linkedPullRequests.title: Fix sudo sfputil show error-status on a multiasic platform issue
linkedPullRequests.author: mlok-nokia
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### What I did
Fixed  "sudo sfputil show error-status" on a multiasic platform issue.  Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/8504

This change is also applicable to 202205 branch

#### How I did it
The current implementation is only hard code to  connect STATE_DB on host database  with SonicV2Connector(127.,0.0.1).   To support the multiasic platform, we need to query the data entry from STATE_DB of namespace database.   Following the existing design to  use multi_asic.get_front_end_namespaces.  And looping the namespaces to get the output_table for each namespace.  
#### How to verify it
1) running the image on a multasic platform which front panel ports have  SFP inserted. 
2) execute "sudo sfptuil show error-status". The output should show all ports with status.
